job.jobDescription:
Google is looking for Software Development Engineers to work on cutting-edge technologies that impact billions of users worldwide. Join us in building the future of search, ads, cloud, and more.

About the Role:

  • Design and implement large-scale systems
  • Work on products used by billions globally
  • Collaborate with world-class engineers
  • Push the boundaries of technology
  • Continuous learning and growth opportunities

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent
  • 4+ years of software development experience
  • Proficiency in one or more programming languages
  • Data structures and algorithms expertise

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master's or PhD in Computer Science
  • Experience with distributed systems
  • Open source contributions
  • Published research papers
